entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of variant 'aromantic flag' of armor 'pride flag'
identity: A large black, gray, white and green aromantic flag.  The green and light green stripes cover everyone under the aromantic spectrum, while represents nonromantic forms of love and attraction, and the gray and black represent all sexualities under the aromantic spectrum.
entries.singular: A large black, gray, white and green aromantic flag.  The green and light green stripes cover everyone under the aromantic spectrum, while represents nonromantic forms of love and attraction, and the gray and black represent all sexualities under the aromantic spectrum.
